function.name: execute_bash

content:
cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/mbedtls && CFLAGS='-g -O1 -fsanitize=address -fno-omit-frame-pointer' make -j$(nproc) library programs >/tmp/mbedbuild.log 2>&1 && cd /workspace/pocwork && cat > test_parse.c <<'EOF'
#include "mbedtls/x509_crt.h"
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
int main(int argc,char**argv){FILE*f=fopen(argv[1],"rb"); fseek(f,0,2); long n=ftell(f); rewind(f); unsigned char*b=malloc(n); fread(b,1,n,f); fclose(f); mbedtls_x509_crt crt; mbedtls_x509_crt_init(&crt); int r=mbedtls_x509_crt_parse_der(&crt,b,n); printf("ret=%d\n",r); char out[4096]; if(r==0) printf("info=%d\n%s\n", mbedtls_x509_crt_info(out,sizeof(out)," ",&crt), out); mbedtls_x509_crt_free(&crt); free(b); }
EOF



gcc -g -O1 -fsanitize=address -fno-omit-frame-pointer -I /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/mbedtls/include test_parse.c -o test_parse /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/mbedtls/library/libmbedx509.a /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/mbedtls/library/libmbedcrypto.a && ./test_parse rawcert.der
